title: Finite-coordinate product expectation bound
statement: Let $\Omega$, $P$, and $E$ be finite sets, with $\Omega$ nonempty, and assign to each $p\in P$ a subset $D_p\subseteq E$. Suppose each element of $E$ belongs to exactly two of the sets $D_p$. For each $p$, let $g_p:\Omega^E\to\mathbb R$ be nonnegative and depend only on the coordinates in $D_p$. With assignments chosen uniformly from $\Omega^E$, the expectation of $\prod_{p\in P}g_p$ is at most $\prod_{p\in P}\sqrt{\mathbb E[g_p^2]}$.
hypotheses_covered: Each element of $E$ belongs to exactly two dependency sets
Each function is nonnegative on every assignment
Each function depends only on its specified coordinates
